dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Adventure Challenge

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Bai
dialogues.text: How's my deck? Not bad, huh? My experience managing the mill came in handy while putting it together.

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Bai
dialogues.text: I've never seen anyone play this way! Is everyone in the city as good as you are?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's not bad.

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Bai
dialogues.text: Thanks, it's always nice to get positive feedback. This is more than just a mill — the tofu we make here is the best in all of Liyue!

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Bai
dialogues.text: I know that sounds like bragging, but it's the truth. Many restaurants in Liyue Harbor order from us, and so does the Wangshu Inn!

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Bai
dialogues.text: Of course, I could talk all day but nothing beats trying it for yourself. Here, have some on the house. If you like it, maybe you can consider buying some more in the future.

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Bai
dialogues.text: Hello, how do you do? We don't often see young people like you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hello.

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Bai
dialogues.text: Just call me Ms. Bai. This is my mill... Or, more accurately, this is the mill that I oversee.

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Bai
dialogues.text: Not bad at all, wouldn't you say?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Young people, you say?

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Bai
dialogues.text: Yes. Most of the young folks have gone out to seek work, and they don't return. We don't get many young foreign visitors either.

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Bai
dialogues.text: Such is the allure of city life, I suppose.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Bai
dialogues.text: Goodbye, and stay safe!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What do you sell here?

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Bai
dialogues.text: Would you like some tofu? I can guarantee that ours will surely satisfy you!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's with the mill?

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Bai
dialogues.text: What's with it? This was left to me by my father. When I returned, I renovated it wholesale, and now maintain it every day.

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Bai
dialogues.text: Maybe my father also once lived this kind of peaceful life... Every time I hear the sound of the water wheel, it reminds me of many things in my childhood.
